title: Price record (SPEC section 15, row 'Price')
description: The reference feed for one asset on one chain. Mirrors the frozen on-chain PricingConfig (Types.sol) plus the evidence section 15 requires: heartbeat, observed p99.9 update interval, aggregator bounds, reference kind, display label, peg assumption and verification date.

feed.description: Chainlink AggregatorV3-compatible feed proxy. PricingConfig.feed. Null only in a standalone record for a local mock aggregator whose address is assigned when the mock is deployed; a deployment manifest always narrows this to an address.

feedIsMock.description: True only for a labeled local mock aggregator. Must be false outside the local environment.

feedDecimals.description: PricingConfig.feedDecimals; must equal the feed's decimals() when read, 0-18.

baseQuote.description: Quote direction of the feed. The reference valuation is always in USD (SPEC section 3.1).

heartbeatSeconds.description: Documented feed heartbeat H. Null only for a local mock with no published heartbeat; the validator then checks maxPriceAge against the bounds alone, and rejects null under rule P1 in any document whose environment is not local (SPEC sections 3.1 and 15).

observedP999IntervalSeconds.description: Measured p99.9 update interval (SPEC sections 3.1 and 15). Null until measured on this chain.

anyOf.description: The block range and sample count observedP999IntervalSeconds was computed over, as printed by scripts/observe_feed.ts. Without it the interval is an unattributable number.

samples.description: Number of aggregator rounds read in the window. A p99.9 needs enough rounds to mean anything.

observationWindow.description: Provenance of observedP999IntervalSeconds. Required by rule P8 on mainnet; null or absent elsewhere.

maxPriceAge.description: PricingConfig.maxPriceAge = max(2H, 3600), never outside MIN_PRICE_AGE..MAX_PRICE_AGE (Types.sol 60..172800, ADR 020).

minAnswer.description: Aggregator minAnswer circuit-breaker bound, or "0" when the aggregator has none. PriceReader.validateConfig rejects negative bounds, so this is unsigned.

maxAnswer.description: Aggregator maxAnswer circuit-breaker bound, or "0" when the aggregator has none.

answerBoundsConfirmedAbsent.description: Explicit confirmation that the aggregator exposes no minAnswer/maxAnswer, as opposed to the bounds simply not having been checked (SPEC section 15).

referenceKind.description: PricingConfig.referenceKind. UnderlyingAsset requires a recorded peg assumption and a visible label (SPEC section 3.1).

displayLabel.description: Wording the app and Verify page must show for an UnderlyingAsset reference. The manifest supplies the wording; the frozen enum makes it mandatory.

pegAssumption.description: The recorded peg assumption behind an UnderlyingAsset reference.

verifiedOn.description: Date the chain, quote direction, decimals, heartbeat, status and asset association were verified at deployment.
